svg.text: Wayfarer v0.5.7 habitat: five decks for 6 crew and 4 guests
Pressure vessel 8.6 m across, x 0.2-13.7 m. Net habitable volume 322 m³ (32.2 m³ per person). 22 windows, 16 couches and berths, two ladders per deck.

g.text: Deck x 0.2-3.0 m from the bow; floor at x 3.0 m; clear height 2.3 m. Looking aft (down under thrust).
Net habitable volume on this deck 51 m³; 6 acceleration couches
Grey dashed: flight deck 1.77 m up, carrying PILOT and NAV on their backs facing the bow; four support couches lie along the rim.
Purple dashed: inner edge of the sensor ring overhead. Blue dashed: the eight nose windows. Red: eye points.
